description: Returns every workspace of the signed-in account: name, slug (the value of the workspace argument of the other tools), companyId, the account's role there, setUp (true once the workspace holds records, false while it is still empty; null when it cannot be used), records (the record count), usable with the unavailableReason and a plain unavailableExplanation when the workspace cannot be used through this connection, and plan. plan holds the workspace's plan facts on Cloud (null elsewhere): plan is the current plan id, onFreePlan whether it runs on the free plan, trialDaysLeft the days left in the free trial (null when not in a trial), lostOnFree what stops working on the free plan as { kind, count } entries, keepsItRunning the cheapest plan that keeps all of it running (null when nothing would be lost) and choosePlanUrl the absolute link to the workspace's billing settings where a plan is chosen. canCreateWorkspace tells whether this connection may create another workspace. With an API key only the key's own workspace is listed.
name: list_workspaces
title: List workspaces
